records.localization_note: Hodram Bergstrom remains the approved short nameplate. The source calls to his name and surname use their separate substitutions.
Janus Pasar is the established navigator's caption. Hodram recognizes him before explaining his injury.
Julio Erneco is the speaker who notices the figurehead and calls to the priest and admiral in turn.
Cesare Tony gives his own view of the warm figurehead. The rewards distinguish his given name from the captain's substitution.
Charles Rochefort remains the short nameplate for his convoy letter. His registered signature elsewhere in that letter remains intact.
Fernando Dias remains the nameplate for the sailor who reads the puzzle and reacts to the voice. Use the established ASCII capital F.
Yuris Huygens is the established caption, and the dialogue establishes his name, estate, and duties.
Port Worker stays the shared source role for the man offering gloves and the messenger who brings news from the guild.
Priest matches the source church role. Father is Julio's form of address in dialogue.
Guildmaster identifies the official giving the survey and search assignments. His familiarity with Yuris belongs to the conversation.
Follower is the existing role for the visitor buying maps. The encounter supplies no new name or rank.
Francisca is the approved caption for the woman who identifies the stolen Frozen Rose and offers the church tip.
Margrete keeps her approved spelling and speaks about a sailor's story in her own voice.
Wanda gives her own answer about the town's ruins. Her caution differs from the other hostesses' leads.
Julia greets the captain and gives a separate account of the ruins around her town.
Myrine greets the captain and points out the visible hill. The approved short name stays consistent.
Nelly promises directions to the pyramids and keeps her own familiar greeting.
Hatra recommends seeing the ruins on a fine day. The treasury remains a claim she attributes to rumor.
Titis is the established short caption for the hostess who makes an exception when sharing the nearby clue.
